items.title: The website is on its way
items.body: The Market now has a home on the web: every plugin, theme, wallpaper, app, cursor and look, with a page of its own as soon as it is approved.

items.title: Thirty gradient themes, six metals and stones
items.body: Thirty gradient themes and gold, silver, bronze, ruby, emerald and platinum, each with a day variant, are built in and ready in the Store.

items.title: The Market opens
items.body: Publish a plugin, theme, cursor, wallpaper pack, look or app with an issue form; the bot checks it and a reviewer approves it at the commit that was checked.
